metadata.pass_rule: main_correct == 1 and all four material-error flags == 0
metadata.review_method: Visual inspection of all 200 images and generated captions; selected full-size photographs inspected for ambiguous details. Model identities known; not a blind independent review.
metadata.posture_rule: Standing, sitting, and lying errors are attribute errors; activities are action errors. Placement errors are relationship errors.
metadata.repetition_rule: Repetition alone is not an object error; omission alone is not a hallucination. An empty or subject-free caption fails main_correct.
metadata.baseline_comparison: Existing author-confirmed ResNet18 generator ratings; not a newly computed ResNet50 retrieval baseline.
